mapper.insert: insert into t_local_message (id, exchange_name, routing_key, message, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{message}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from t_local_message where status IN (0, 2) and next_retry_time <= now() order by create_time asc limit 100
select consumed from t_local_message where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update t_local_message set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update t_local_message set retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime} where id = #{id}
update t_local_message set status = 1 where id = #{id} and status in (0,2)
update t_local_message set status = 2 where id = #{id} and status in (0,2)
update t_local_message set consumed = 1 where id = #{id} and consumed = 0
